key.answer_key: In Al-Cu-Mn (a) the light-contrast phase forms a continuous network along the dendrite boundaries. In Al-Cu-Mn-Sm (b) it appears as isolated particles instead of a network. In Al-Cu-Mn-La (c) it appears as thin, broken strings.
